mostWorthwhile.text: The closing passage connects hydrogen from the early universe with oxygen made in stars, giving the sea a satisfying natural history without implying it was inevitable.

leastWorthwhile.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to compare; the ending itself is very brief.

surprise.text: The explicit reminder that none of these processes was aiming at a sea reframed the story’s apparent destination.

arbitrary.text: No action in this chapter felt arbitrary; there were no actions to take.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue for more natural-process explanations, though this chapter’s brief ending alone gives me little basis for judging further gameplay.
